metadata.audience: English-speaking independent visitors, especially Shanghai extensions, 1–3 days
metadata.promise: Suzhou teaches a visitor how gardens frame movement, water, architecture and time. It is a city first; water towns are optional extensions.
metadata.commercial_boundary: Research and human-checked digital roadbook only. No booking, bundle, guiding, ticket resale or third-party experience sale.

source_policy.rule: Live garden access, museum reservation, night programme, water-town transport and weather require dated official checking.

modules.name: Garden as an instrument of attention
modules.question: Which garden suits the way you want to look, move and rest?
modules.output_rule: Choose one primary garden and a contrast, not a garden marathon.

modules.name: Canal city and ordinary movement
modules.question: How do I connect gardens to the city's water and streets?
modules.output_rule: Build a public walk with time/heat exits; do not make residents or private homes an attraction.

modules.name: Craft, music and Jiangnan cultural labour
modules.question: Do silk, Kunqu, Pingtan, guqin or embroidery actually matter to this visitor?
modules.output_rule: Separate contextual learning from a sellable class/performance; verify all current programmes.

modules.name: Museum and contemporary interpretation
modules.question: How do I add architectural or collection context without overbooking?
modules.output_rule: Use museum/architecture as an optional lens with reservation check.

modules.name: Water-town decision
modules.question: Do I need Tongli/Zhouzhuang after Suzhou?
modules.output_rule: Treat water towns as an extra day with weekday/crowd/transport decision, not as a replacement for Suzhou.

modules.name: Tiger Hill and landscape contrast
modules.question: Do I want a garden interior or a broader hill/pagoda/landscape scale?
modules.output_rule: Use as a contrast, not a compulsory third garden.

modules.name: Shanghai–Suzhou–Hangzhou Jiangnan choice
modules.question: Which Jiangnan city earns the available days?
modules.output_rule: Match garden/canal/craft to Suzhou, lake/tea/temple to Hangzhou; do not force both.

modules.name: Reservation, weather and pace
modules.question: Can this route work on the actual date and body?
modules.output_rule: Surface tickets, rail, heat/rain, stairs and family needs before delivery.

points.name: Humble Administrator's Garden decision
points.why_it_matters: A major garden anchor when the visitor wants layered water, pavilions and a first encounter with Suzhou garden composition.
points.agent_use: Use as one primary garden only; current access must be checked.

points.name: Lingering Garden decision
points.why_it_matters: A different garden lens for visitors interested in sequence, interiors, rockery and framed movement.
points.agent_use: Choose instead of stacking with every major garden.

points.name: Master of Nets / smaller-garden decision
points.why_it_matters: A possible smaller-scale choice for visitors who want a more bounded garden reading or an evening programme subject to verification.
points.agent_use: Never promise night performance or access without current verification.

points.name: Garden-reading card
points.why_it_matters: A deep Suzhou route teaches compression, borrowed view, threshold and paced movement rather than asking a visitor to photograph every pavilion.
points.agent_use: Give one visual/physical question before entry.

points.name: Pingjiang Road public-street decision
points.why_it_matters: A legible old-city water/street layer, useful when framed as public movement and commerce rather than timeless authenticity.
points.agent_use: Make it a paced public walk; do not treat residents as content.

points.name: Shantang decision
points.why_it_matters: A canal-side commercial/night layer that can fit lively visitors but is not automatically the best old-city experience.
points.agent_use: Ask whether the visitor wants energy or quieter canal observation.

points.name: Grand Canal public-space lead
points.why_it_matters: A research lead for water infrastructure and city movement beyond tourist lanes.
points.agent_use: Do not build a route until field-checked.

points.name: Kunqu/Pingtan programme decision
points.why_it_matters: Performing arts can make Jiangnan cultural life audible, but a client may want theatre, tea-house ambience, language access or none of these.
points.agent_use: Ask form and English-explanation needs; verify all programme details.

points.name: Silk / embroidery / craft learning lead
points.why_it_matters: Craft is a credible research lane, but not a promise of an ethical workshop, English instruction or product quality.
points.agent_use: Capture interest only until supplier and consent gates pass.

points.name: Suzhou Museum decision
points.why_it_matters: A potential bridge between garden/urban history and contemporary museum architecture, if reservation and crowd constraints fit.
points.agent_use: Use as one lens, not an obligatory addition to two gardens.

points.name: Museum-plus-garden pacing card
points.why_it_matters: Two attention-heavy interiors can overwhelm a single day; the product has to leave room for water and streets.
points.agent_use: Choose one primary interior and one outside layer.

points.name: Tongli water-town decision
points.why_it_matters: A separate water-town day may suit a visitor who explicitly wants bridges, canal scale and a slower exterior rhythm after Suzhou.
points.agent_use: Use only with extra time; prefer a current weekday/crowd and access check.

points.name: Zhouzhuang decision
points.why_it_matters: A more iconic water-town choice for clients who knowingly value image/recognition and accept crowd/commercial trade-offs.
points.agent_use: Never rank universally; make trade-offs explicit.

points.name: Water-town refusal card
points.why_it_matters: Many visitors have only a day. Suzhou gardens and canals can be more coherent than forcing a distant water town.
points.agent_use: State that skipping a water town is a valid deep choice.

points.name: Tiger Hill decision
points.why_it_matters: A different scale—hill, pagoda and landscape—when the visitor needs relief from enclosed garden rooms.
points.agent_use: Use as contrast to one garden; assess terrain and heat.

points.name: Shanghai day-trip decision
points.why_it_matters: A same-day Suzhou route should be one garden plus canal/old-city movement, not museum, Tiger Hill and water town together.
points.agent_use: Ask arrival station, hotel and one primary lens.

points.name: Suzhou overnight decision
points.why_it_matters: Overnight is valuable for a second garden, a calm evening water layer or a deliberate water-town decision.
points.agent_use: Use when two cultural layers genuinely matter.

points.name: Hangzhou versus Suzhou choice
points.why_it_matters: Suzhou is garden/canal/craft density; Hangzhou is lake/tea/temple/landscape. Short stays should choose rather than duplicate Jiangnan imagery.
points.agent_use: Ask what kind of attention the traveller wants.

points.name: Arrival/payment/weather audit
points.why_it_matters: Rail station, payment/data, named reservations and wet/hot weather shape whether the first garden is a pleasure or a queue.
points.agent_use: Ask practical readiness before Day 1.

points.name: Ethical canal-city observation
points.why_it_matters: A deep route observes public urban life without turning homes, residents and workers into a visual resource.
points.agent_use: State public/private etiquette explicitly.

signals.meaning: Start one garden plus canal structure.
Ask desired scale and choose one primary.
Ask meal form, no stale list.

follow_up_questions.ask: Is Suzhou a same-day return or an overnight, and what is the one thing you most want it to do?
Do you want a first iconic garden, rockery/interiors, a smaller quiet scale, or garden architecture?
Do you have a separate extra day, and do you value quieter canal time or iconic image despite crowds?
Are you looking for context, a performance, a workshop or something to buy? Current access and language must be checked.
Do you want gardens/canals/craft or lake/tea/temple, and how many days can you actually give Jiangnan?
What weather, walking or stair threshold needs a shorter or indoor alternative?
Would you like a human-checked brief with official links while you make bookings directly?

output_guardrails: Never add Tongli/Zhouzhuang to a one-day Suzhou plan by default.
Never promise tickets, night performance, craft workshop, water boat, weather or live transport without dated verification.
Never call commercial old streets inherently authentic.
Never use residents/private homes as an attraction.
No booking, payment collection, packaging, guiding, transport or third-party experience sale.

launch_checks.purpose: Station transfer, reservation and usable time

launch_checks.name: Canal public-walk audit
launch_checks.purpose: Ethics, crowd, night return and heat
